mechanics.title: Hand rendering in boats
mechanics.description: Optionally renders held items while the boat is moving. A client config lists which items stay displayed (supports 'modid:*' wildcards).

qol: Held item visible in a moving boat
getting_started: Configure via the client config (config/boatiview) or Mod Menu. Check that 'Show Items in Moving Boat' is enabled.
editor_notes: Modrinth says to set showHandsInMovingBoat to true to enable it, so it may be off by default; pack config for it not verified.
name: Boat Item View
summary: Shows the item in your hand while you sit in a moving boat, which vanilla hides. Rendering only; you still cannot use the item.
